notes: CrowdStrike Parsing Standard 1.2 extends ECS with LogScale-specific rules. The bundled rule records cover required tags, naming rules and conditional alert fields; other requirements of the specification are outside this dataset. source_hash is null because the canonical source is a rendered HTML page rather than a versioned artifact.

Elastic Common Schema 9.4.0 vocabulary: 2,725 field names in 44 field sets. The bundle includes field names and field-set membership. Other release vocabularies and value-level conformance are outside this dataset. A documented field name does not establish that a deployment emits it.
IANA IPv4 Special-Purpose Address Registry: address blocks and their Globally Reachable flag.
about_Pwsh: -EncodedCommand | -e | -ec; the Base64 representation must be a UTF-16LE encoded string.
about_PowerShell_exe: -EncodedCommand and -EncodedArguments take UTF-16LE Base64; no short forms listed.
